svg.aria-label: A shared operations floor: an AI agent holds a ring of keys wider than its task, marks a ticket done beside an unchanged record, copies a file a colleague already edited, and sends every ticket to a slow planner so the queue and the spend grow; a reviewer stamps a tall pile unread and the alarm lamp lights after a change
svg.title: The pain: authority wider than the task, work that looks finished, a queue and a bill that grow
